== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ヤヴィン4：マサッシ遺跡</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">リーダーがいてここを占領していれば、自分の各宇宙戦闘機はデス・スター星系カード上でそれぞれ戦闘力＋1となる。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">ここを支配したなら、フォース消耗を＋1できる。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — The printed game-text box is blank.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Light uses 占領 (occupy) where English uses control, and 宇宙戦闘機 (starfighters) where English uses starships. Light says デス・スター星系カード上 (on the Death Star system card). Dark uses できる (may) for Force drain +1.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-yavin4massassiruins.gif|Original English face]], [[Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins]].</ref>
